## Main is RED on the gating cell

Scheduled Test Suite run `33950878570` (2026-09-05 06:49 UTC, `headSha a33333b8709a`) failed the
**gating** cell `build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)`:

```
FAILED tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_code_review_tools.py::
       test_ac3_verifier_routing_gets_distinct_fresh_terraform_session
    assert len(opened) >= 2 and len(set(opened[:2])) == 2
E   assert (2 >= 2 and 1 == 2)
```

Two sessions were opened, but they were the SAME session — `set(opened[:2])` has one element where
the test requires two distinct ones. The test's name states the contract: the verifier routing must
get a *distinct fresh* terraform session.

Four `sweep` lanes also failed in the same run (`macos full suite`, `py3.15`, `py3.14t`,
`windows`). `sweep (windows)` is `continue-on-error` by design and is tracked by the Windows
support-target epic; the other three sweep lanes are NOT yet triaged and may or may not share this
cause — establish that rather than assuming it.

## Prime suspect, stated as a LEAD not a finding

`git log` shows the failing test file was last modified by **`25d1d683e55a` — "Add probe_source
Terraform grounding tool"** (Gerrit change 2645), which also added the `probe_source` tool to
`src/rebar/grounding/`. That change modified both the test and the module under test.

Timeline supports it but does not prove it:

    01:07 UTC   scheduled Test Suite  SUCCESS
    ~05:xx      25d1d683e55a merges
    06:49 UTC   scheduled Test Suite  FAILURE, in a test that commit touched

A session-routing change that makes two calls share one session is exactly the shape of `1 == 2`
here. But confirm by bisecting or by reading the diff — do not assume.

## It does NOT reproduce on a default local checkout

```
$ pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_terraform_code_review_tools.py::test_ac3_... -q
1 skipped in 3.86s
```

The test opens with `pytest.importorskip("hcl2")`, so it SKIPS wherever the `hcl2` extra is absent.
CI runs it because that lane sets `REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1`, which turns an `importorskip` that
would skip into a hard error. **Install the extra before attempting a reproduction**, or the test
will silently not run and a green local result will mean nothing — the same skip-is-not-a-pass
trap this repo has already been bitten by (bug `599e`, and the chromium tier in `337e`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] The failure is REPRODUCED locally with the `hcl2` extra installed, and the reproduction is
      shown failing for the stated reason (`1 == 2` on distinct sessions) rather than erroring or
      skipping.
- [x] The cause is established by evidence — diff reading or bisect — and named. If `25d1d683e55a`
      is NOT the cause, say so and name what is; a refuted lead is a valid outcome.
- [x] The gating cell `build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)` passes on `main`.
- [x] Whichever side was wrong is fixed on its merits: either the routing genuinely lost session
      distinctness (fix the code) or the test's expectation is stale against a deliberate design
      change (fix the test AND state why the old contract no longer holds). Do not simply relax the
      assertion to make it pass.
- [x] The three untriaged sweep-lane failures (`macos full suite`, `py3.15`, `py3.14t`) are each
      recorded as same-cause or different-cause with evidence. Do not fold them in silently.
